_notes: The collision masks of the sprite sheets a battle tests for contact, from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef), as sprite-masks.json records the others: each frame as _GetCelData loads it, read by UQM's own PNG loader, with its colour key set as process_image sets it, and a pixel able to touch as TFB_DrawCanvas_Intersect decides it; the planets, true colour without alpha, converted to the screen's 32 bits first, as TFB_DrawImage_New converts them (TFB_DisplayFormatAlpha to the 32-bit screens without alpha): the images program models that step, as its SDL stand-in has no conversion.

Collisions test the big size only (InitIntersectFrame takes the frame from farray[0]), so only it is here: sis_ship, ilwrath, arilou, spathi, supox, druuge, yehat, zoqfot, thradd, umgah, utwig, mycon, androsyn, mmrnmhrm, chenjesu, slylandr, urquan, blackurq, human, chmmr, shofixti, syreen, orz, melnorme, vux, pkunk's ship, weapon and special sheets as data/ships.json names them, and their status panel's icons (frame 1 is the ship's silhouette, which ModifySilhouette in weapon.c tests the VUX's limpets against: every frame is here), the asteroids, blasts and explosions (InitSpace), graphics.stars (floating crew, lasers and ion trails are its last frame) and every planet's battle sprite (load_gravity_well).
By resource id, each frame is [width, height, hot spot x, hot spot y, SHA-256 of the mask: a byte a pixel, row by row, 1 where it can touch]. Content, so hashes only.

frames: every graphics resource a battle draws (every fighting ship's ship, weapon and special sheets at their three sizes, its captain's window and status icons; the stars, the status panel, the explosions, blasts and asteroids at three sizes, every planet's battle sprites), its frame count as _GetCelData loads it (an image that doesn't load is dropped).
